title: Sun Tone Bronzing Crème Hydrating Cream Bronzer
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cream Formula✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Gluten Free✓ Without Parabens✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora
What it is: A cream-to-powder bronzing duo for a dimensional, bronzed look and a hydrated-matte finish; it’s two tones mimic the warmth of naturally sunkissed skin.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Coconut-Derived Emollients: Provides glide and a weightless, smooth feel.
- Avocado Fruit Extracts: Improves the look of firmness and elasticity, hydrates, and reinforces skin barrier.
- Shiitake Mushroom Extracts: Reduces the appearance of pores, controls shine, hydrates, and soothes.

Ingredient Callouts: It is also vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Curated tones layer and blend seamlessly for sunkissed dimension.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply the lighter shade anywhere the sun would naturally hit—on the apple of the cheek and high points of the face. Apply the deeper shade along the cheekbones, hairline, and temples to add depth and dimension.
-Blend with the Blender II Brush for a seamless, bronzed finish.
-Gucci’s Tip: "It’s easier than you think: Lighter on the high points, deeper on the edges. Together, they create that sunkissed dimension you can't get from a single shade.
Ingredients+
-Coconut-Derived Emollients: Provides glide and a weightless, smooth feel.
-Avocado Fruit Extracts: Improves the look of firmness and elasticity, hydrates, and reinforces skin barrier.
-Shiitake Mushroom Extracts: Reduces the appearance of pores, controls shine, hydrates, and soothes.
Left:
Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate, Lauroyl Lysine, Mica, Glyceryl Tribehenate/Isostearate/Eicosandioate, Titanium/Titanium Dioxide, Glyceryl Behenate/Eicosadioate, Boron Nitride, Corthellus Shiitake (Mushroom) Extract, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Fruit Extract, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Dicalcium Phosphate, Kaolin, Silica, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, 774992), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090), Red 7 (CI 15850), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Ultramarines (CI 77007).

Right:
Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate, Lauroyl Lysine, Dicalcium Phosphate, Glyceryl Tribehenate/Isostearate/Eicosandioate, Mica, Glyceryl Behenate/Eicosadioate, Titanium/Titanium Dioxide, Boron Nitride, Corthellus Shiitake (Mushroom) Extract, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Fruit Extract, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Kaolin, Silica, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, 774992), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090), Red 7 (CI 15850), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Ultramarines (CI 77007).
